subject: Post-call: isolation requirements and PoC timeline
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Asha Kaplan <asha.kaplan@novushealth.com>, Tom Liu <tom.liu@novushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap — isolation requirements & practical path forward

Hi Asha / Tom,

Thanks again for the time this morning. Below is a short written recap of the constraints you described, the goals we heard, and a concrete set of next steps so we can keep momentum during your security and procurement reviews. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points we heard
- Data residency requirement: PHI and state-level residency (CA) — no cross-region replication outside the contracted region.
- Network isolation: security team expects no public-model egress from customer VPC; all model traffic must stay on private subnets with enforced egress controls.
- Key management: customer-managed KMS/HSM required for model keys and logs retention encryption.
- Audit/forensics: retention of detailed audit logs for 3+ years, and log export into your SIEM (Splunk).
- Timeline sensitivity: procurement + security review target window ~10–12 weeks, with an Ask from security for a PoC that proves the isolation model first.

PoC goals (aligned with what you asked for)
- Security: demonstration of customer-managed keys and no public outbound flows from model hosts.
- Ops: ability to deploy Redwood runtime in a restricted VPC (customer-controlled) with narrow egress to an approved endpoint (or none).
- Performance: p95 token-latency at or below 350ms for a 64-token request profile in the PoC baseline.
- Observability: show console-less telemetry export to your S3 bucket / Splunk for audit.

Immediate next steps (owners & timeline)
1) Redwood: share a VPC checklist and initial SOW outline for an isolation PoC (attached). Due: 2027-04-07. Owner: olga_petrov.
2) Novus: confirm KMS model (BYOK/HSM) point-of-contact and any required attestation paperwork. Due: 2027-04-12. Owner: Asha.
3) Redwood SEs: schedule a 60-min technical deep dive with Novus infra/security to walk proposed VPC topology and egress control options. Target week of 2027-04-12. Owner: ben_carter / marissa_cole.
4) Novus: internal procurement/schedule decision window (informal) — aiming for 10–12 weeks from today; please confirm procurement owner + expected decision date. Owner: Tom.

Attachments: novus-sow-outline.pdf (PoC scope sketch), redwood-vpc-checklist.xlsx (network questions and pre-reqs)

If these look right I’ll convert the outline to a short SOW artifact and circulate for your security team to review. Happy to jump on a follow-up call — I’m available Wed/Thu afternoons PT.

Thanks,

Olga Petrov
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0121

From: Asha Kaplan <asha.kaplan@novushealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Liu <tom.liu@novushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 17:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — isolation requirements & practical path forward

Olga —

Thanks for the clear write-up, that matches our notes. A few clarifications from security and infra:

- Residency: CA-only storage for PHI is non-negotiable. We will need a clear statement in the SOW about region enforcement and data-at-rest location.
- KMS: we do require BYOK and periodic HSM attestation. Is Redwood able to integrate with our Azure Key Vault/HSM (we currently run a hybrid KV model)?
- Telemetry: security will want the option to disable any console-hosted telemetry and instead push events to our Splunk index.
- No cross-cloud replication: any failover or backups must be staged in a CA-only account or snapshot location; no cross-region/CSP replication without explicit approval.

Separately — curious if the PoC can run in our dev VPC behind a network NAT that blocks outbound traffic except to a narrow list of IPs (we want to avoid any public egress during test). Can Redwood run with zero public egress and remote management via an approved bastion?

We’ll confirm procurement owner tomorrow, but likely Sarah Meyers (procurement) will be the lead. Tentative procurement window is 10 weeks.

Asha Kaplan
Head of Security Programs | Novus Health
asha.kaplan@novushealth.com
From: Tom Liu <tom.liu@novushealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Asha Kaplan <asha.kaplan@novushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — isolation requirements & practical path forward

Thanks Olga — 

Quick confirmation from my side: procurement is aware and Sarah will lead the commercial review. We expect security sign-off steps to be the gating item; our security governance requires a technical PoC before we move forward to a commercial agreement. I asked Sarah to join the first technical deep dive if possible.

One ask from Ops: during the PoC we want visibility into resource utilization (GPU/memory) and a simple breakdown of estimated unit cost at the PoC scale and at projected production scale. Will Redwood provide that?

If we can get a clear list of network pre-reqs and the BYOK integration approach, we can usually make the PoC happen inside our dev VPC (with the NAT restrictions Asha described).

Tom Liu
Director, Platform Engineering | Novus Health
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap — isolation requirements & practical path forward (internal next steps)

Olga / Marissa — forwarding the thread for internal action. Short internal plan based on the asks above: 

- Ben (SE): draft a recommended VPC topology that supports zero public egress and bastion-based management; include NAT whitelisting option, subnet placement, and route table examples. Deliverable: vpc-deployment-draft-20270406.docx (attached). ETA: EOD Thur 2027-04-08.
- Marissa (Solutions Eng): validate BYOK integration approach with the infra team (Azure Key Vault/HSM flow) and write a short runbook for key rotation constraints. ETA: 2027-04-09.
- Olga: produce an SOW addendum paragraph covering CA-only residency and audit log retention to attach to the PoC SOW. ETA: 2027-04-07.
- Internal: prepare cost delta estimates for isolated PoC vs Hosted Redwood — focus on GPU hours, egress patterns, and storage snapshots.

I’ll kick off a calendar poll for the technical deep dive with Novus for next week.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
